newsitem.title: USA: O'Reilly Automotive Q4 net, sales climb.
newsitem.headline: O'Reilly Automotive Q4 net, sales climb.

text.p: O'Reilly Automotive Inc said Tuesday it posted higher earnings in the fourth quarter ended December 31 thanks to a solid increase in sales.

The company reported net income of $4.5 million, or $0.43 a share, up from $3.6 million, or $0.38 a share one year ago. Sales in the period reached $64.7 million, up from $50.9 million in the corresponding period in 1995.
The company also said it plans to open 40 new stores in 1997 and an additional 50 stores in 1998.
O'Reilly Automotive is a specialty retailer and supplier of automotive aftermarket parts and accessories.
Its shares closed down 1/8 Tuesday at 31-3/8.
